items.question: In what manner are suffering and happiness distributed among all beings?
premises: All beings are included without exception.
Suffering and happiness form a paired set.
Both states are characterized as equal for all beings.
items.inference: Suffering and happiness are equally shared by all beings.
items.plain_english: For all beings indeed, both suffering and happiness are equal.
